subject: English 1st Paper

source.edition: Revised for the year 2026; revised edition October 2025

passagePolicy: Use the specifically cited source section in the NCTB textbook. Full textbook passages and images are not reproduced. Original writing models are not source facts.

activities.instruction: Answer using the cited text. Equivalent accurate wording is acceptable; support interpretations with details.

items.question: Why is Robin excited in Section A?
items.modelAnswer: He has received an invitation from his aunt to stay with her family in the countryside during his holiday.

items.question: Who is Maher?
items.modelAnswer: He is Robin’s cousin and is about Robin’s age.

items.question: What does the invitation ask Robin to tell the family?
items.modelAnswer: It asks him to let them know when he will arrive.

items.question: Where do the hosts say they will receive Robin?
items.modelAnswer: They say they will meet him at the bus station.

items.question: What is the main purpose of Robin’s later letter?
items.modelAnswer: Its main purpose is to thank his aunt for inviting him and for the enjoyable stay.

activities.instruction: Explain the word in the cited context, or give the requested alternative meaning. Accept suitable equivalent wording.

acceptedAnswers: a request to visit or take part
meet or welcome someone in this context
feel someone’s absence and wish to be with them

activities.instruction: Write an original short invitation to a friend for a supervised daytime visit.
activities.modelAnswer:
Dear Rafi,
I would like to invite you to our home next Friday afternoon. We can read our new storybooks and work on our class poster together. Please ask your parents first. Our families can agree on the time and travel arrangements. Let me know whether you can come. I hope we can spend an enjoyable afternoon together.
Your friend,
Nabil
activities.note: Original model with no copied textbook dates or invented source chronology. Supplementary lesson writing, not an official additional examination slot.
assessment: Addresses the task with relevant details
Uses a clear sequence and connected sentences
Uses suitable vocabulary and comprehensible grammar
Accept original accurate responses; do not require memorisation

limitations: Initial Draft pool, not exhaustive chapter quotas or a complete model paper.

Bus travel is implied by reception at the bus station, not explicitly narrated. No unsupervised child-travel advice.
